## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `start_indexer` | `start_indexer(config_path: tstr) -> int` | Boot ingestion against the indexer config at `config_path` (must be an ABSOLUTE path — the module runs in a logos_host subprocess). |
| `stop_indexer` | `stop_indexer() -> int` | Stop ingestion and release the FFI handle. |
| `reset_storage` | `reset_storage(config_path: tstr) -> int` | Stop the indexer (if running) and delete the RocksDB store for the config's channel — `<storage>/rocksdb-<channel_id>`, where `<storage>` is resolved the same way start_indexer resolves it (the host's instance persist… |
| `getAccount` | `getAccount(account_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Account by id, accepting Base58 (canonical) or 32-byte hex. |
| `getBlockById` | `getBlockById(block_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Block by decimal block id. |
| `getBlockByHash` | `getBlockByHash(hash: tstr) -> tstr` | Block by 32-byte hex hash. |
| `getTransaction` | `getTransaction(hash: tstr) -> tstr` | Transaction by 32-byte hex hash. |
| `getBlocks` | `getBlocks(before: tstr, limit: tstr) -> tstr` | Page of blocks: `before` = "" for the tip, else a block id to page back from; `limit` is the decimal max count. |
| `getLastFinalizedBlockId` | `getLastFinalizedBlockId() -> tstr` | Tip block id as a bare decimal string. |
| `getStatus` | `getStatus() -> tstr` | Current ingestion status as the core's `IndexerStatus` JSON, passed through verbatim: { state (Starting/Syncing/CaughtUp/Error/Stalled), last_error, indexed_block_id, stall_reason }. |
| `getTransactionsByAccount` | `getTransactionsByAccount(account_id: tstr, offset: tstr, limit: tstr) -> tstr` | Transactions touching `account_id` (Base58 or 32-byte hex), paginated by decimal `offset`/`limit`. |
